INFO.NAME: PhilipsHue
INFO.AUTHOR: Albrecht
INFO.DESCRIPTION: Philips Hue Bridge connection: lights, groups, scenes, sensors, automations and presence (geofencing)

PVSTRING.DESCRIPTION: IP address of the Hue Bridge on the local network, e.g. 192.168.1.20

PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION: On connection loss, automatically looks up the bridge's current IP via discovery.meethue.com (Philips' cloud service) and adopts it if it has changed. Requires internet access - leave off and maintain the IP manually (or fix it via a DHCP reservation in the router) if no internet access is available
Write 1, then press the link button on the bridge within 5 minutes

PVSTRING.DESCRIPTION: Hue application key. Filled in automatically during pairing, or can be entered manually if a key from another installation already exists

PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION: Write 1: queries all lights/groups/scenes/sensors/rules from the bridge and lists them with their Hue ID in STATUS.Inventory

Write 1: assigns the IDs found on the bridge to the instances already created in the editor (Lights/Rooms/Scenes/Sensors/Automations) in order - instance 1 gets the first ID found, instance 2 the second, etc. Only empty ID fields are filled in, existing assignments are kept

Write 1: queries the states of all configured lights/groups/sensors/scenes/automations (and presence, if enabled) once from the bridge. Otherwise only runs once at startup - the installation rarely changes
Queries the home/away status of the Hue app via CLIP v2 (HTTPS). Requires the JVP HTTP resource to accept HTTPS with the bridge's self-signed certificate
Write 1 to reset the debug log

PVSTRING.DESCRIPTION: Text status of the pairing process
List of all lights (Hue ID + name), generated via CONFIGURATION.DUMP_INVENTORY
List of all groups/rooms (Hue ID + name), generated via CONFIGURATION.DUMP_INVENTORY
List of all scenes (Hue ID + name + target group), generated via CONFIGURATION.DUMP_INVENTORY
List of all sensors (Hue ID + name + type), generated via CONFIGURATION.DUMP_INVENTORY
List of all rules/automations (Hue ID + name), generated via CONFIGURATION.DUMP_INVENTORY

PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION: At least one device registered in the Hue app reports 'home' (only with geofencing enabled)

PVSTRING.DESCRIPTION: Rolling log of the latest E:trace messages, to copy for troubleshooting
ID of the light on the bridge (see log after the initial pairing)

PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION: Seconds between automatic status queries for this light, default 10s for newly created instances. 0 = no automatic polling (status only queried once at startup or via Refresh states)

PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION: Receive datapoint: current switch state as reported by the bridge

PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION: Receive datapoint: current brightness as reported by the bridge
Send datapoint: sets the color temperature in Kelvin (2000=warm white .. 6500=cool white)
Receive datapoint: current color temperature as reported by the bridge
Send datapoint: sets the hue angle in degrees (0..360), color lights only
Receive datapoint: current hue angle as reported by the bridge
Send datapoint: sets the saturation, color lights only
Receive datapoint: current saturation as reported by the bridge

PVSTRING.DESCRIPTION: ID of the group/room on the bridge

PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION: Receive datapoint: current switch state as reported by the bridge

PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION: Send datapoint: sets the brightness of the group/room
Receive datapoint: current brightness as reported by the bridge

PVSTRING.DESCRIPTION: ID of the scene on the bridge

Group/room the scene is recalled in (0 = all lights). Automatically taken from the bridge when reloaded, provided the scene is assigned to a room - for roomless scenes (light scenes) the manually entered value is kept
Name of the room/group this scene belongs to (resolved from Target group ID) - to tell apart identically named scenes in different rooms, e.g. multiple 'Nightlight' scenes
ID of the sensor on the bridge
e.g. ZLLPresence (motion), ZLLTemperature, ZLLLightLevel, ZLLSwitch/ZHASwitch (button/remote/doorbell), ZHAOpenClose/CLIPOpenClose (window contact), Daylight

PVANALOG.DESCRIPTION: Temperature in °C, lux, presence/contact 0/1, or button event, depending on type

PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION: Only set for window contacts (type ZHAOpenClose/CLIPOpenClose): 1=open, 0=closed

PVSTRING.DESCRIPTION: ID of the rule/automation on the bridge

PVBINARY.DESCRIPTION: Receive datapoint: current state as reported by the bridge

PVTIME.DESCRIPTION: Time at which JVP detected the last trigger
